purpose: Show a parallel or contrasting aspect.
keywords: Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + 一方で
While user numbers are rising, staff numbers are falling.
Alongside her research, she writes books for children.
The internet is convenient, but checking information is essential.
formation: Plain clause / Nである / な-adjectiveな + 一方で
restrictions: Can contrast groups or show two activities of one person.
mistake: Do not confuse 一方で with 一方だ, a continuing trend.
